Petiti  Through: Mr. Hemant Kumar, Advocate.
 versus  STATE GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI & ANR. .....
Responden  Through: Mr. Hemant Mehla, APP for State  with IO/SI Ashok Kumar.

Mr. Virender Singh, Advocate for   2.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GIRISH KATHPALIA  ORDER % 04.02.2026 CRL.M.A. 3769/2026 (exemption)
1.
Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 865/2021 of Police Station Wazirabad for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that State has no serious objection to this petition.
4. Respondent no.2 identified by IO/SI Ashok Kumar also accepts notice.
5. For recording statements of parties, list before the concerned Joint Registrar on 09.03.2026.
